tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
Tenders from Joint ventures and sub contractor will not be accepted.
Conditional tenders will not be accepted.
The tenderer shall bear all costs associated with the preparation and submission of his tender, and the employer will in no case be responsible and liable for those costs.
The cost of the Tender Processing shall not be refundable.
The employer is not responsible for any delay in accessing e - Procurement Portal.
Bank Guarantee will not be acceptable for EMD. EMD should be paid as specified in the e-procurement schedule.
Financial Bid will be opened only after the complete evaluation and acceptance of Technical Bid.
In all matters of dispute, the decision of the University is final and bidders shall legally bind to it.

The Bidder offering services should have at least 3 years experience in providing such services to reputed organizations/govt/central govt and Universities, Names and Address of the Organizations to whom services have been provided for the past three years shall be furnished.
The price quoted should be valid for the whole of the contract period.

The Bidder should have minimum turnover of not less than Rs.110.00 lakhs in any two financial years during last five financial years i.e., 2020-21 to 2024-25. And bidder should upload the consolidated Annual Turnover which should be attested by Chartered Accountant and copies of the audited balance sheets
Food shall be supplied to all centers/Dept/Offices/Institutional points of the University of Mysore as per the supply order and as per agreed rates

The qualify for award of the tender, the bidder should have Executed at least one similar service of not less than Rs.55.80 lakhs during last five financial years i.e., 2020-21 to 2024-25 to any of the govt organizations.
Having solvency certificate of value not less than Rs.11.00 lakhs issued from any of the nationalized or scheduled or commercial bank.
Self declaration stating the firm is not blacklisted with any Government/Quasi Government Organizations and will not supply Refurbished equipments on Notarized Rs.100/- Non Judicial e-stamp paper.

Interested tenderers may obtain further information or clarification related to the tender either in person or through phone during office hours at University Engineering Division, University of Mysore, Mysuru and also may contact through telephone No.s.: 0821-2419312
